first.rationale: Prioritize a targeted onboarding-simplification experiment because both onboarding completion and activation are declining, and prior evidence indicates streamlined onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Verify the onboarding result and promotional-pricing retention tradeoff before committing. Do not default to competitor-matching pricing: it may acquire price-sensitive SMBs but has previously reduced 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue. Guard the test with qualified activation, conversion quality, and early-retention measures, since the current declines may have causes beyond onboarding friction.
